questions.text: Have activities that normally interest you seemed less enjoyable than usual?
Have you spent a lot of time feeling unhappy or without hope?
Has your sleep been disrupted or much longer than usual?
Have you struggled with tiredness or too little energy for daily tasks?
Has your appetite changed substantially, whether eating less or more?
Have you judged yourself harshly or felt you had let people down?
Has staying focused on reading, studying, or watching something been difficult?
Have you moved or spoken unusually slowly, or felt noticeably more restless?
Have thoughts about ending your life or deliberately hurting yourself occurred?

safetyFlag.name: self_harm_thoughts
safetyFlag.instructions: Never wait for a total score to respond to this item; offer urgent local help when there is immediate danger. Have a clinician design and review the workflow.
